name: silvestar/yaml-custom-fields
description: A WordPress plugin for managing YAML frontmatter schemas in theme templates

scripts.lint:syntax: find src templates -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P4 php -l > /dev/null && echo 'Syntax OK'

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check WordPress Coding Standards (phpcs.xml.dist records what is enforced)
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Apply the auto-fixable coding standards fixes
scripts-descriptions.lint:diff: Lint only the files changed since the last commit
scripts-descriptions.lint:report: Show remaining findings grouped by sniff, most frequent first
scripts-descriptions.check: Before every commit: syntax, coding standards, unit tests
scripts-descriptions.check:release: Before a release: check, plus the audit scripts and the scoped build. The build runs before the tests on purpose - the shipped autoloader is classmap-authoritative, so the tests have to run against the build that is about to ship, not the one left over from last time
